# Walnut Markets

> Walnut Markets is a stock research terminal for self-directed investors. It brings fundamentals, technicals, analyst expectations, insider filings, Congress activity, institutional holdings, government contracts, macro context, and other evidence into one workflow so investors can assess agreement, conflict, change, catalysts, risks, and what to watch next.

Walnut Markets is operated by Walnut Intelligence Inc. It provides research and informational tools only, not investment advice, trade signals, or personalized recommendations.

## Preferred pages

- [Homepage](https://walnutmarkets.com/): Product overview and stock research workflow.
- [Pricing](https://app.walnutmarkets.com/pricing): Free, Premium, and Pro plans.
- [About](https://app.walnutmarkets.com/about): Operator, support, data provenance, and billing context.
- [FAQ](https://app.walnutmarkets.com/faq): Data, disclosure timing, billing, privacy, and product answers.
- [Compare Walnut](https://walnutmarkets.com/compare): Compare Walnut with other stock research tools.
- [Congress Trades](https://walnutmarkets.com/congress-trades): Reported U.S. Congress trading disclosure context.
- [Confirmation Score](https://walnutmarkets.com/stock-confirmation-score): Methodology and limitations for Walnut's proprietary research metric.

## Important context

- Reported disclosures and public records can be delayed, corrected, incomplete, or unavailable.
- Walnut's Confirmation Score is an interpretive, point-in-time research metric; the underlying evidence remains visible for review.
- Historical or backtested strategy results are research context, not forecasts or guarantees.
